_설명: 『運転手のくせに』 PHASE 4 키프레임 g: 2컷 x 후보 2장 = 4장, 약 0.16달러. 생성: scripts/build_untenshu_keyframes.py (스토리보드 keyframe_prompt + 시트 칸 참조).

characters.prompt: Create ONE single photorealistic cinematic film still — one frame only, NOT a grid. Reference images: the people's faces, hair and clothes must match their reference images exactly (same person); the last reference is the location — keep its space and lighting. Photorealistic live-action Japanese TV drama, Arri Alexa cinematic color grade, Kodak 35mm film grain, 24fps, 16:9, restrained Japanese film mise-en-scene, natural lived-in detail, no flat lighting. Taxi cabin layout (right-hand drive): the driver in the FRONT right seat, Ogawa in the REAR seat behind the front passenger seat; lace covers on every headrest. Camera on the dashboard at the front passenger side looking back between the two front seats into the rear seat: Ogawa in the back seat leaning slightly forward into the gap between the front seats, holding the small plain silver photo frame (exactly the frame in the reference image, palm-sized) out toward the driver with both hands, gentle and apologetic; at the left edge of the frame the driver is seen in side profile, the car parked, his head turned only slightly toward her. Characters: Ogawa Yui, a slim Japanese woman aged 26, a kind gentle oval face with natural light makeup, soft brown shoulder-length hair tied in a low ponytail with soft side-swept bangs, no glasses, wearing a plain beige trench coat over a plain navy trouser suit | Kuroda Soichiro the taxi driver, a lean Japanese man aged 67, a long calm dignified face, thick white hair swept back under the cap, a short neatly trimmed white moustache, one small dark mole on his RIGHT cheek, no glasses, wearing a plain navy peaked driver's cap with no badge, plain white cotton gloves, a white shirt with a plain navy V-neck vest, seen in side profile at the frame edge facing forward toward the windshield. People look like real Japanese drama actors photographed on set: real skin texture with visible pores and fine lines, subtle asymmetry, natural matte skin, restrained believable expressions, bare unadorned earlobes and no jewellery. Camera: eye-level, 85mm prime lens, f/1.8, shallow depth of field, razor-sharp focus on the irises, soft optical bokeh. Lighting: inside a taxi at night: soft teal and amber street-light stripes sliding across the faces, a faint dashboard glow from below, faces clearly readable. Car-interior geometry: the driver always faces forward toward the windshield; the passenger in the back seat speaks toward the driver from behind. The speaker's face at least one quarter of the frame height at a three-quarter angle, sharp focus on the speaker's eyes; the driver only a soft side profile at the frame edge. All papers, screens, signs, cards and labels are completely blank; no letters, numbers or symbols anywhere in the frame. Any car license plate is a plain green plate with a thin white border and no characters; any taxi roof lamp is a plain white dome with no characters. Negative: gibberish, foreign text, incomprehensible letters, fake alphabets, blurry typography, text on badge, text on name tag, logo on shirt, signage lettering, kanji on lanterns, posters with writing, documents with writing, screens with text, printed labels, brand logos, characters on license plates, watermarks, stamps, symbols on collar, bad anatomy, deformed eyes, extra fingers, extra arms, duplicate people, blood, gore, police. Car-interior conversation framing: the speaker's face fills at least one quarter of the frame height and is in razor-sharp focus; the other person is only a soft side profile at the frame edge: a driver always faces forward toward the windshield, never turned toward the back seat; rear-seat passengers sit side by side on the same bench facing forward, never face to face; the speaker's mouth is gently CLOSED in this frame (speech is added later), emotion shown in the eyes, brows and jaw. Natural five-fingered hands only where described. Every paper, document, card, screen, meter display, license plate and roof lamp surface is completely blank and clean: NO characters, NO numbers (Japanese text is composited later). Full-frame 16:9 image filling the whole canvas: NO black bars, NO white borders, NO letterbox or pillarbox.
